messages:
sophia: Intake for stonefly-13b-int8 bring-up. Goal: hosted + dedicated rollout. Main asks: prioritization, quant eval, quality/regression thresholds (<=1.5% drop), p95 latency target <220ms hosted small-batch, canary + fallback plan. cc @ajay @maria @leo

ajay: Quick Q — which eval sets are we using? And are we comparing to raven-13b baseline or current prod (vesta7b)?

maria: I'll run eval-suite (conv, QA, summarization) against raven-13b and prod vesta7b today. Will post numbers by EOD.

leo: Deployment modes question — propose hosted canary first (5% -> 20%) then dedicated ramp. Private not in scope for Q1 right?

sophia: Correct, private not in scope for initial bring-up. Plan is hosted canary -> monitor -> dedicated. Canary windows: 4h for perf/errs stability, 24h for quality signals.

clare: Fallback plan idea: auto-route to raven-13b or vesta7b depending on latency/cost policy. Immediate rollback triggers: >2% error spike or >10% sustained latency degradation.

ajay: Acceptance criteria suggestion: metric delta <=1.5% vs raven on eval set; hallucination FPR <0.8%; token-cost delta <15%.

maria: Draft bench numbers from local infra: ```model | p95_latency_ms | tokens/sec | avg_cost_per_1k
stonefly-int8 | 210 | 320 | $0.55
raven-13b | 185 | 360 | $0.65
prod-vesta7b | 200 | 340 | $0.60``` Need hosted run for final numbers.

sophia: Can we also run a hosted smoke replay with real traffic? @infra-bot can you schedule a canary job and replay?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled replay job created -> jobs/stonefly-smoke-2315000012. ETA ~45m. Logs -> https://logs.redwood/internal/jobs/2315000012

leo: Traffic split sample for the config file: ```routes:
 - name: stonefly-canary
   percent: 5
   health_checks: [errors, latency, custom-eval]
 - name: stonefly-canary-20
   percent: 20
``` Will attach canary_id + runbook details to the PR.

sophia: Monitoring hooks: add eval-set regression triggers to Console, set automatic fallback if quality alert fires twice within 2h, and add token-level tracing for latency hotspots.

clare: :thumbsup: Also add quota guardrails for canary so it can't spike usage accidentally.

ajay: Add quantization smoke tests: synthetic int8 vs fp16 with max seq 1024; verify no OOMs and decoding divergence <0.5%.

maria: Uploading eval artifacts here: https://s3.redwood/evals/stonefly/2315000000/artifacts.tar.gz

sophia: Short rollout checklist: 1) eval numbers posted 2) hosted smoke replay 3) 5% canary (4h perf window) 4) 20% canary + 24h quality monitoring 5) warm dedicated pool 6) promote to prod. Objections?

leo: No objections. I'll own topology + routing changes.

ajay: I'll own eval pass + regression alerts.

maria: I'll own benchmarking and artifacts.

sophia: I'll coordinate rollout and final signoff. Targeting canary tomorrow morning if smoke passes.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: smoke job finished -> status: success. logs -> https://logs.redwood/internal/jobs/2315000012 (2 failed requests, within tolerance)

sophia: :tada: Great — starting 5% canary now. Kickoff timestamp: 2315000300. Will post updates in thread.
